scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:maquette
scripts.test:e2e: vite build && cargo build -p steno-cli --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml && playwright test --project=maquette --project=reel
scripts.test:e2e:reel: vite build && cargo build -p steno-cli --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml && playwright test --project=reel
scripts.captures: vite build && cargo build -p steno-cli --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml && playwright test --project=captures
